body:
### Description

scipy.ndimage.correlate support `mode='grid-constant'` but the cupyx analog does not

```
In [1]: import cupy as xp

In [2]: from cupyx.scipy import ndimage as c_ndi

In [3]: c_ndi.correlate(xp.array([[1, 2, 3],
   ...:                           [4, 5, 6]], dtype=xp.int8),
   ...:                 xp.array([[1., 0.],
   ...:                           [0., 1.]], dtype=xp.float32),
   ...:                 mode='grid-constant')
   ...: 
   ...: 
   ...: 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RuntimeError                              Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In[3], line 1
----> 1 c_ndi.correlate(xp.array([[1, 2, 3],
      2                           [4, 5, 6]], dtype=xp.int8), 
      3                 xp.array([[1., 0.],
      4                           [0., 1.]], dtype=xp.float32), 
      5                 mode='grid-constant')

File ~/.conda/envs/scipy-dev/lib/python3.11/site-packages/cupyx/scipy/ndimage/_filters.py:43, in correlate(input, weights, output, mode, cval, origin)
     12 def correlate(input, weights, output=None, mode='reflect', cval=0.0, origin=0):
     13     """Multi-dimensional correlate.
     14 
     15     The array is correlated with the given kernel.
   (...)
     41         from SciPy due to floating-point rounding of intermediate results.
     42     """
---> 43     return _correlate_or_convolve(input, weights, output, mode, cval, origin)

File ~/.conda/envs/scipy-dev/lib/python3.11/site-packages/cupyx/scipy/ndimage/_filters.py:155, in _correlate_or_convolve(input, weights, output, mode, cval, origin, convolution)
    153 def _correlate_or_convolve(input, weights, output, mode, cval, origin,
    154                            convolution=False):
--> 155     origins, int_type = _filters_core._check_nd_args(input, weights,
    156                                                      mode, origin)
    157     if weights.size == 0:
    158         return cupy.zeros_like(input)

File ~/.conda/envs/scipy-dev/lib/python3.11/site-packages/cupyx/scipy/ndimage/_filters_core.py:61, in _check_nd_args(input, weights, mode, origin, wghts_name)
     60 def _check_nd_args(input, weights, mode, origin, wghts_name='filter weights'):
---> 61     _util._check_mode(mode)
     62     # Weights must always be less than 2 GiB
     63     if weights.nbytes >= (1 << 31):

File ~/.conda/envs/scipy-dev/lib/python3.11/site-packages/cupyx/scipy/ndimage/_util.py:92, in _check_mode(mode)
     89 if mode not in ('reflect', 'constant', 'nearest', 'mirror', 'wrap',
     90                 'grid-mirror', 'grid-wrap', 'grid-reflect'):
     91     msg = f'boundary mode not supported (actual: {mode})'
---> 92     raise RuntimeError(msg)
     93 return mode

RuntimeError: boundary mode not supported (actual: grid-constant)
```

_No response_
title: ndimage.correlate does not support `mode='grid-constant'`
